title: Open TTS Leaderboard compares five tiny TTS models side by side
summary: Hugging Face's open leaderboard now lists Paradee v1.3 (0.69% WER at 8M params), PiVo (0.77% at 1.4M), phonon-31m, ZONOS3-Mini and Underdog-Woof, with open scripts and p95 CPU latency (PiVo 6ms, phonon 28ms with streaming and cloning).

appearances.title: Phonon leads Open TTS intelligibility in German and Spanish
appearances.summary: Gradium's on-device Phonon text-to-speech model, small enough to be compared with systems up to 100 times its size, ranks first for intelligibility in German and Spanish on the Open TTS Leaderboard. It also places in the top three for every language evaluated and leads CPU streaming time-to-first-audio.
